site.about:
The choir started in 2009 with eleven people around a borrowed piano in the church hall. We still rehearse in the same room.

We sing everything from gospel to folk to the odd pop song, and we perform four times a year, always free. Dues keep the lights on; nobody is turned away for not paying them.

data.title: Welcome to our new director
data.summary: Maria takes the baton this autumn.
data.body:
After twelve years, our founding director is handing over to **Maria Ortega**, who has led the youth choir since 2019.

Maria's first rehearsal is Tuesday. Come and say hello; there will be cake.
